concepts.headline: Journaling for spiritual growth.
concepts.supporting: Write freely. Over time, see what God has been making of you.
concepts.proof: Your own words · week, month, quarter, year
concepts.primaryText: A quiet place to write—and, over time, to see what your own words have been carrying. No streaks. No scores. Nothing invented.

concepts.headline: Spiritual growth is slow. See its shape over time.
concepts.supporting: Week, month, quarter, and year—grounded only in what you actually wrote.
concepts.primaryText: A day can feel ordinary. A year can reveal a pattern. Dayspring reflects your writing back without grading your walk with God.
concepts.assetAlt: Dayspring Ascent showing a year of grounded reflection

concepts.headline: You wrote the prayer. Remember what came after.
concepts.supporting: The people and matters you carry, gathered gently across the years.
concepts.primaryText: Prayers should not disappear into a pile of pages. Dayspring gathers what you brought to God so you can return without turning prayer into a task list.
concepts.assetAlt: Dayspring Altar gathering prayers over time

concepts.headline: Beautiful to write in. Made for the inner life.
concepts.supporting: Scripture, prayer, and contemplative practices—inside a writing surface that stays quiet.
concepts.proof: No streaks · no badges · no sermonizing
concepts.primaryText: Dayspring is a serious journal for practicing Christians: a beautiful editor with Scripture, Prayer, Sense, and Ritual built into the page.
concepts.assetAlt: Dayspring writing surface with scripture and prayer

concepts.headline: Ten years of journaling. One story you've never read.
concepts.supporting: Bring in Day One or Diarly with original dates preserved, then see what has been happening.
concepts.proof: A journal that reads your history back
concepts.primaryText: You wrote faithfully. The entries piled up. Dayspring brings in your history and returns its seasons, prayers, and passages in your own words.
concepts.assetAlt: Dayspring history view after journal import
